_comment: SSOT for cited-evidence integrity on comparison/method guides. Each source is classified ONCE by reading the actual abstract (author + finding + polarity), then scripts/lint-citations.mjs enforces it deterministically on every build. polarity is relative to the page's RRM-favorable thesis: 'supportive' (helps the RRM case), 'neutral' (methods/background or a fair counterweight), 'critical' (skeptical of or unfavorable to RRM). A 'critical' source may be cited honestly but must NOT carry supportive framing words (flagship/landmark/proves/etc.). Adding a new citation REQUIRES adding it here with a verified polarity. Verified against NCBI/DOI 2026-06-15.

restorative-reproductive-medicine-rrm-ou.finding: First head-to-head RRM vs IVF registry comparison; 41% crude live birth (n=187).

natural-procreative-technology-naprotech.finding: NaPro cohort n=1310; 62.1% adjusted cumulative take-home baby rate.

healthy-singleton-pregnancies-from-resto.finding: RRM after failed IVF, n=403; 32.1% adjusted live birth.

international-natural-procreative-techno.finding: iNEST enrollment/methods paper; prospective cohort, 834 couples, 10 clinics/4 countries; reviews 29-66% adjusted cumulative LBR range.

the-effectiveness-and-safety-of-restorat.finding: SKEPTICAL systematic review by IVF clinicians; found ZERO controlled comparative studies; concluded no reliable evidence RRM matches/beats IVF and that RRM may delay effective treatment.

complications-related-to-in-vitro-reprod.finding: Narrative review; IVF complications support implementing natural/restorative approaches. NOT a gestational-surrogate study.

comprehensive-diagnostic-and-therapeutic.finding: Andrological workup achieved spontaneous pregnancy in 40.9% of couples; cut 'unexplained' to 8%. NOT authored by Bozhedomov.

ovarian-hyperstimulation-syndrome-a-narr.finding: OHSS narrative review; severity classes, hospitalization for severe cases. No single clean incidence rate.

cancer-in-children-born-after-frozenthaw.finding: Nordic cohort; FET vs spontaneous childhood-cancer aHR 1.65 (overall ART-vs-spontaneous not significant).

livebirth-rate-associated-with-repeat-in.finding: Cumulative IVF live birth rises across repeat cycles (a fair counterweight to per-cycle figures).

22611174.finding: IVF/ICSI singletons: elevated preterm (RR 1.54), GDM, hypertensive disorders.

29202976.finding: Gestational-surrogate within-woman model; IVF singletons worse outcomes than carriers' own natural pregnancies.

23562045.finding: Fertility treatment: childhood-cancer RR 1.33 (may reflect underlying subfertility).

35176012.finding: US ART multiple-birth rate 21.4% vs 3.3% general population (2018).

complete-laparoscopic-excision-of-endome.finding: Complete laparoscopic excision of typical and atypical endometriosis in 17 teenagers achieved zero recurrence at repeat surgery (avg 23.1 mo) without postoperative hormonal suppression, supporting fertility-preserving excisional surgery over hormonal bypass.

reproductive-capacity-and-recurrence-of-.finding: Retrospective series of 206 stage III/IV endometriosis patients showed 65.8% postoperative pregnancy, 93.2% symptom relief, and only 21.8% recurrence after fertility-preserving surgical resection, with laparoscopy yielding higher pregnancy rates.

the-optimal-time-for-laparoscopic-excisi.finding: RCT (n=88) found laparoscopic endometrioma cystectomy timed to the late luteal phase significantly reduced AMH decline and ovarian tissue loss versus early follicular phase, optimizing ovarian-reserve preservation during restorative surgery.

endometriosis-and-infertility-a-long-lif.journal: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
endometriosis-and-infertility-a-long-lif.finding: Narrative review of endometriosis-associated infertility weighing surgery versus ART; balanced, noting surgery's iatrogenic ovarian-reserve risks while increasingly favoring ART, with no directional endorsement of restorative surgery.

changes-in-circulating-hormone-levels-af.finding: Small mechanistic study (n=9) of hormone changes after ovarian wedge resection in PCOS: androstenedione/DHEA-S dropped at 5 days but rebounded by 6 weeks; mostly ovulatory cycles restored at 6-12 mo but pregnancy in only 2 cases.

women-with-polycystic-ovary-syndrome-wed.finding: Long-term cohort of 33 PCOS women wedge-resected decades earlier; documents spontaneous restitution of cyclic regularity over time but focuses on persistent metabolic morbidity (hypertension, diabetes), a natural-history study with no surgical-efficacy verdict.

fertility-following-bilateral-ovarian-we.finding: Critical analysis of 90 PCOS wedge-resection cases: 91% ovulation restored but only 47.8% crude conception, attributing the gap to oligo-ovulation and BOWR-induced tuboperitoneal adhesions (>=7.8% pelvic disease, 8% ectopic), cautioning that this restorative surgery can induce mechanical sterility.

myomectomy-as-a-reproductive-procedure-r.journal: American Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology
myomectomy-as-a-reproductive-procedure-r.finding: Series of 64 fertility-preserving myomectomies; 40% live birth among those attempting pregnancy; concludes hysterectomy is not an alternative when childbearing is desired.

myomectomy-for-fertility-enhancement-and.finding: Review concluding abdominal myomectomy is an appropriate fertility-preserving alternative to hysterectomy; >50% of previously non-pregnant women conceive, with acceptable risk.

tuboplasty-b1yfsfsh.finding: Slug did not resolve: get returned null twice, search returned no results, and SQL queries errored. Record appears absent or the slug is malformed (non-rec suffix differs from the batch pattern).

reconstructive-tubal-surgery-uxepd2vs.finding: Early article on reconstructive (fertility-restoring) fallopian tube surgery; metadata-only record (no abstract/body), but topic is restorative tubal repair.

reconstructive-tubal-microsurgery-and-as.finding: Editorial positioning reconstructive tubal microsurgery as a viable fertility-restoring alternative to ART for tubal-factor infertility (rrm_relevance 4.0).

salpingoscopic-findings-in-women-with-oc.finding: Diagnostic salpingoscopy study triaging proximal tubal disease; ~80% had normal endosalpinx suitable for microsurgical tubal reconstruction, ~19% bipolar disease referred to IVF.

a-narrative-review-of-platelet-rich-plas.journal: Journal of Assisted Reproduction and Genetics
a-narrative-review-of-platelet-rich-plas.finding: Narrative review of autologous PRP for thin endometrium, poor ovarian reserve, and recurrent implantation failure; reports promising trends but calls for more research.

clinical-efficacy-of-a-novel-method-of-f.finding: Prospective trial of a novel fertility-preserving (uterus-sparing) adenomyomectomy in 45 women with severe diffuse adenomyosis: 54.5% conceived postoperatively with relief of dysmenorrhea/menorrhagia and no uterine rupture, supporting conservative surgery over hysterectomy.

uterine-closure-after-cesarean-delivery-.journal: American Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology
uterine-closure-after-cesarean-delivery-.finding: Argues a refined 3-layer cesarean closure that restores uterine anatomy and excludes endometrium produces stronger scars and prevents isthmoceles, adenomyosis, infertility and accreta; meticulous anatomy-respecting repair should take precedence over fast single-layer closure.

isthmocele-and-infertility-recwpl3h1tdyz.finding: Review linking cesarean-scar isthmocele (incidence 20-70%) to impaired fertility; documents the post-cesarean defect as a fertility problem and outlines RMT-guided surgical correction (hysteroscopy vs laparoscopic/vaginal repair) while cautioning against operating on all asymptomatic patients.

isthmocele-from-risk-factors-to-manageme.finding: Comprehensive review of isthmocele as a consequence of cesarean section covering pathophysiology, symptoms, classification, diagnosis and medical/surgical management; documents the conventional-surgery harm and calls for unified classification to guide repair.

an-overview-of-postoperative-intraabdomi.finding: Narrative review: postoperative adhesions occur after >90% of gynecologic surgeries and cause up to 40% of female infertility; emphasizes microsurgical/gentle technique, avoiding unnecessary surgery, and gel barriers to prevent the iatrogenic harm of conventional surgery.

contemporary-adhesion-prevention-recoz8w.finding: Review of peritoneal adhesion formation and prevention; key finding that peritoneal suturing increases adhesions while denuded peritoneum heals well, and physical barriers (Interceed, Gore-Tex) reduce adhesions, supporting fertility-preserving microsurgical practice.

varicocele-management-for-infertility-an.finding: PRISMA systematic review: varicocelectomy yields 26-40% spontaneous pregnancy and ~90% pain improvement, with microsurgical subinguinal repair giving the best fertility outcomes and lowest complications; supports restorative fertility-preserving surgery over bypass.

recurrent-varicocele-3adlmoxn.finding: Systematic review of varicocele recurrence rates (0-35% by technique), anatomic causes, and management; methods-oriented review with no directional fertility thesis, though microsurgical subinguinal noted as lowest-recurrence approach.

surgical-techniques-for-the-management-o.finding: Balanced overview of male-infertility surgery (diagnostic biopsy/FNA, varicocelectomy, vasectomy reversal, sperm retrieval); documents restorative surgical benefits but frames care as couple-based and ART-inclusive (IVF-ICSI), no single directional thesis.

gnrh-agonists-in-the-treatment-of-sympto.finding: Conventional pro-GnRH-agonist review; suppression manages symptoms, disease recurs after stopping (53.4% at 5yr, orig. Waller & Shaw). Cited for the recurrence fact, not as anti-suppression evidence.

endometriosis-quality-of-life-cohort-stu.finding: Radical excision cohort; durable pain/QoL improvement up to 10y; 77.1% of those desiring pregnancy conceived (70% naturally).

20356588.finding: RCT excision vs ablation: no significant 12-mo pain difference for superficial disease; trend favoring excision for dyschezia.

a-randomized-trial-of-progesterone-in-wo.finding: PROMISE RCT n=836; empiric first-trimester progesterone did NOT improve live birth in unselected recurrent miscarriage (65.8% vs 63.3%, ns).
PRISM RCT; overall null, but benefit in the prior-miscarriage + current-bleeding subgroup, scaling with number of prior losses.

micronized-vaginal-progesterone-to-preve.finding: Critical re-evaluation: no benefit unselected; benefit in bleeding + prior-loss subgroup. Supports SELECTING who gets progesterone.

progesterone-profiles-in-luteal-phase-de.finding: Subset of RPL women have deficient luteal-phase progesterone profiles; identifying them is relevant to treatment response.

progesterone-in-women-with-recurrent-mis.finding: RRM critique of PROMISE: empiric untargeted progesterone started after conception in unselected women is the wrong design; diagnose + time treatment.

31056315.finding: Meta-analysis (1,013 men): sperm DNA fragmentation higher in RPL partners; male factor relevant to RPL.

42062119.finding: ASRM committee opinion on recurrent pregnancy loss; notes LPD lacks a standardized validated diagnostic test.

myoinositol-as-a-safe-and-alternative-ap.finding: Myo-inositol improves ovarian function + metabolic parameters in anovulatory PCOS.

metformin-increases-the-ovulatory-rate-a.finding: Metformin raises ovulatory + pregnancy rate from clomiphene in clomiphene-resistant PCOS.

metformin-therapy-throughout-pregnancy-r.finding: Metformin through pregnancy reduces gestational diabetes in PCOS.

25006718.finding: RCT n=750: letrozole > clomiphene on ovulation + live birth in PCOS; twin rate numerically lower (not significant).

letrozole-or-clomiphene-for-infertility-.finding: Correspondence related to the Legro letrozole-vs-clomiphene RCT.

polycystic-ovary-syndrome-pathophysiolog.finding: PCOS pathophysiology + IVF outcomes incl. elevated OHSS risk.

laparoscopic-ovarian-drilling-for-ovulat.finding: Cochrane review: LOD may slightly LOWER live birth vs medical ovulation induction (OR 0.71), but fewer multiples + no OHSS.

sperm-dna-fragmentation-and-recurrent-pr.finding: Meta-analysis (1,013 men): sperm DNA fragmentation higher in RPL partners; male factor relevant to RPL.

30095777.finding: Systematic review of FABM effectiveness (perfect + typical use across methods).

17371516.finding: Marquette monitor + mucus method efficacy; perfect-use ~2/100.

35321484.finding: Marquette Method multisite effectiveness study (typical-use range).

29376054.finding: Achieving pregnancy with primary-care FABM interventions; Marquette TTC ~83% by 12 cycles.

12923157.finding: German time-to-pregnancy study; ~81% conceive by 6 cycles, 92% by 12 with fertile-window timing.
